shortcuts.title: Keyboard shortcuts
shortcuts.note: Shortcuts are off while you type in an input field.

verdict.down_text: chronyd is not running – devices on the LAN are not getting time right now.
verdict.island_text: No time source reachable – the clock is free-running
verdict.syncing_text: chrony is still looking for a reliable source
verdict.good_text: The clock is synchronised and every part is running.

ntp.title: Time sources (NTP)
ntp.description: Where this server itself gets its time from.

lan.title: Time server for the LAN
lan.description: Who may ask this server and how it answers.

nts.title: NTS (Network Time Security)
nts.description: Cryptographically secured time – as a client and optionally as a server.

dns.title: DNS for ntp-gui
dns.description: Which DNS servers ntp-gui itself uses to resolve the names of its time sources – against loops when the LAN DNS rewrites time server names to ntp-gui.

gps.title: GPS / GNSS
gps.description: A GPS receiver as a reference clock of its own (stratum 0).

ptp.title: PTP (IEEE 1588)
ptp.description: Precision time over the network – needs suitable hardware.

language.label: Dashboard language
language.note: Applies to this browser only; without a choice German is used (English is in beta).
language.note_more: So far the navigation, the header, the status band on the overview and the sections here are translated – everything else, the ⓘ explanations and messages from the server are German for now.

settings.only_changed_none: Nothing in this area differs from the default.

badge.reset_title: Back to the default – takes effect when you save

preview.title: Preview: what saving writes
preview.unused: not used – stays as it is
preview.truncated: Shortened – the difference is very long.
preview.none: chrony.conf and ptp4l.conf stay as they are – the change only affects the dashboard.

settings.leave: The settings have unsaved changes. Leave anyway? The changes will be lost.

help.german_only: The explanations on this page are only available in German for now. Translations are welcome – see CONTRIBUTING.md.

api.title: API & automation
api.intro: For monitoring, scripts and Home Assistant. Once a password is set you need an API key (Settings → Dashboard → API keys); only /healthz is always open.
api.status: Overall state as JSON (the same data as the dashboard)
api.healthz: Short liveness check for containers and load balancers
